title: Whiting events in the world's lakes
summary: Detecting whitings — sudden calcite precipitation that turns lakes milky — across thousands of lakes in the ESA CCI Lakes reflectance record, to map where and when they happen and what drives them.
details: A robust detection pipeline combines seasonal harmonic baselines, anomaly detection on blue–green–red reflectance and brightness, and spectral confirmation tests, followed by a machine-learning classifier on event features.

title: Carbon in drying lakes
summary: How hydrological contraction and exposed sediments reshape the carbon budget of shrinking lakes: primary production, pelagic calcification and carbon emissions, with an optical remote sensing component. Field expedition to the Caspian Sea planned for May–June 2027.
details: Includes a ¹³C protocol to measure primary production and pelagic calcification simultaneously during short in situ incubations.

title: Separating bubbles from diffusion in chamber fluxes
summary: An aquatic extension of the goFlux R package that processes floating-chamber CO₂ and CH₄ measurements and separates ebullitive from diffusive flux automatically, tested on synthetic and around 800 real incubations.

title: Lake surface roughness and gas exchange from radar
summary: A GLEON collaborative project testing whether SAR imagery can map lake surface roughness and, combined with mixed-layer depth, serve as a proxy for the gas-exchange coefficient — a major source of uncertainty in lake emission estimates.

title: Colour and water quality of Pyrenean high-mountain lakes
summary: Sentinel-2 time series of water colour, chlorophyll and suspended matter for hundreds of high-mountain lakes in the Pyrenees, paired with decades of in situ chemistry to detect long-term trends.
details: In situ records show consistent declines in nitrate and rising alkalinity, in line with recovery from acid deposition.

title: Saline fronts along the River Gambia
summary: Tracking the position of the saline front along the River Gambia over four decades with harmonised Landsat and Sentinel-2 imagery, and linking salinity to carbon cycling along the estuary.

title: Lake metabolism under internal waves
summary: Estimating gross primary production, respiration and net ecosystem production from high-frequency oxygen profiles, after correcting the oxygen signal for internal-wave motion. Applied to Gergal reservoir.

title: Hydrological regimes of Canary Islands streams
summary: Characterising flow intermittency in Canary Islands streams by combining water-presence sensors, interviews, citizen observations and aerial photographs, and relating regimes to macroinvertebrate communities.

title: Primary production and optics of Lake Geneva
summary: Using high-frequency optical profiles and oxygen measurements on the LéXPLORE platform to diagnose primary production and ecosystem metabolism in a large, deep lake.

title: River water quality across the Australian continent
summary: Bayesian analyses of concentration–discharge relationships and two decades of water-quality trends in Australian rivers, revealing deterioration in Great Barrier Reef catchments and recovery in the Murray–Darling Basin.

title: Eutrophication of the Loire River
summary: Modelling and long-term analysis of phytoplankton, nutrients and invasive clams in one of Europe's largest rivers, including the QUAL-NET high-resolution eutrophication model developed during my PhD.
